measurement_method.operation_runtime: In-process repeated runtime harness (`archive_profile_001_operation_runtime_sections_reports_p50_p95`) measuring export/validate/import wall time inside server paths
measurement_method.hot_sections: In-process repeated section timing for manifest load + signature, archive data load, digest check, timeline validation, and import apply
measurement_method.memory_gate: Process peak working set sampling for the runtime harness cargo command

optimization_slice.change: Add external manifest metadata cache keyed by file revision (`len_bytes` + `modified_unix_nanos`) so repeated validate/import loads on unchanged manifests reuse verified metadata and skip re-read/re-parse/re-signature-verification.
optimization_slice.expected_effect: Lower repeated validate/import overhead for drill lanes that reuse the same file/object manifest reference during a run

notes: Run-03 confirms second optimization slice impact while preserving conformance for DRILL-001/002 lanes.
Manifest load/signature remains the largest single stage and is the next candidate for further reduction if tighter targets are introduced.
